en: I am Bruno of the Elite Four! My Pokémon and I have trained together until we move as one.
We will smash anything that stands in our way, with all the strength our bodies hold!
Our strength... wasn't enough? Hah! Then we have a long way still to climb.
The door is open. Go on, and don't you dare lose after beating us.
You beat us fairly. My Pokémon and I will be back on the mountain tomorrow, training harder than ever.
